senses.gloss:
एर्वारु(क)
(1) [CUCUMIS MELO LINN. VAR. MOMORDICA DUTHIE ET FULLER]
(Chopra; HK; KB 2, p. 1142; Watt CP, p. 438-439); see Duthie 1,
p. 340-342; = C. MOMORDICA ROXB. (Avk; Chopra; HK; Kav; KB 2,
p. 1142; Nadk. 1, nr. 729);
(2) [C. MELO LINN. VAR. UTILISSIMUS DUTHIE ET FULLER] (KB 2, p.
1143); see Duthie 1, p. 340-342; = C. UTILISSIMUS ROXB. (Avk; Bpn,
p. 671; Gul; HB; HSu; KB 2, p. 1143; MW; PW; Vśs).
